title: Spinning Wheel of Wonder & Season Award preview
flavor: We’ve all heard about children’s Circus Story after running away from home. But I never had an interest in children. It’s far easier to take so-called heroes away. And they are exactly the right people to be trained. Arrogance always plays a role in their fantastic show. Uhu, a new victim appears...  by Cogliostro Kettle

entries.name: Wheel of Wonder
entries.detail: New relic. <Relic Consumable: Click to Use> Choose an ally piece, DISCOVER a special duplicate of it with an extra random synergy. * Recruit the discovered pieces with the only Token granted by Wheel of Wonder, no gold required. * Extra synergy can be any of the existing synergy in game. * The target can be any of your pieces, including Undead, Pandaren, IO etc.

entries.name: Greevil’s Egg
entries.detail: Reworked. Nest was cancelled and remade into a CLICK-To-USE relic. The egg will not stop growing after the relic terminates. Chances for growing every round decreased to 50%. <Relic Consumable: Click to Use> Put a piece into an egg which has a chance to grow once every round. You can break it anytime, hatching a piece according to the points. * ★★ for no less than 3 points, ★★★ for no less than 9 points. * Hatching points deduct pieces from the chess pool and will stop growing when there are no pieces in the chess pool.

entries.name: Chiaroscuro Certainty
entries.detail: Reworked. Win or lose streak will not be terminated with this relic. +1 Award removed. Your win or lose streak will not be terminated and when the relic disappears, you will receive a corresponding level loot token based on the highest reward/compensation held during that time.

entries.name: Weaponsmith
entries.detail: Remaining chance for reforger shown in the relic slot.

entries.name: Mango Tree
entries.detail: Remaining chance for mango shown in the relic slot.

entries.name: Synergies are shown in Icons instead of Texts in Recruit Panel
Win or lose streak always shown in the top bar now (Only no less than 2 streak can be shown previously)
Mech - Heart of the Machines
entries.detail: Golden Heart of the Machines Reworked <Courier consumable: Click to use>DISCOVER a panel of 5 random Legendary chess pieces. * Recruit the discovered pieces with Tokens granted by Heart of the Machines, no gold required. Tokens can be keeped for the following discoveries. * Each piece costs 1 token, and benefits from Talent Greedy.

entries.name: Diffusal Blade
entries.detail: Reworked Attack speed + 20%. When attacking a new target, purify the victim by removing all its synergy buffs.
